reason: Seeing the cash drawer, cancelled bills and who is in which chair from my phone matters to me after losing staff last year, and the risk is small: only ₹5,000 up front, the second half only if my stylists actually use it, and three months with no monthly fee. I will still ask them to bring the setup fee down before I sign.
objection: The offer says the training is in Odia, Hindi or English, but it does not say the app screens and WhatsApp bills are in Hindi or Odia. My stylists will not use an English-only app. And ₹10,000 for setup still feels high for an app that is mostly installed on phones we already have.
would_change_my_mind: If they show me the app is only in English, or if they won't give me in writing that the ₹500 stays locked and the ₹5,000 refund is real, I would not go ahead.
